applies_to: abep_sim/atmosphere_orbit.py + atmosphere_msis21_orbit_v1 (A9.16 ATM lane), docs/evidence/sputter_yields_v1, docs/requirements/rfp_official, F0 performance baseline (A9.14 S10.2)

WINDS.summary: build atmosphere v2 with HWM14 neutral winds; carry both the Earth-corotating and the HWM14-corrected relative-flow result; record HWM14 version, Ap input, date/time, coordinates and provenance; v1 never overwritten; v2 is a design-envelope/parametric dataset until the real orbit is registered

ORBIT.summary: 96.3 deg / dawn-dusk stays CODE_DEFAULT / PARAMETRIC, never a requirement input; envelope stays broad until DRDO / spacecraft ICD / PDR mission definition supplies inclination and LTAN; then a new dataset version

DATA_SIZE.summary: keep the frozen dataset as repository evidence (one canonical compressed copy, builder, manifest, sha256); not packaged in the installed wheel unless runtime code genuinely needs it; immutable external artifact if versions start bloating history

SPUTTER.summary: E_screen = 1.10 x E_threshold and F_worst = 1.25 frozen now as owner-defined screening guardbands; the earlier results are not pre-registered evidence; regenerate the register from unchanged source data; screening/down-selection only, never P4 acceptance/lifetime/qualification (S5.12 governs); no later adjustment

RFP.summary: official RFP is the authoritative requirement source; the public repository carries the provenance record (document identity, filename, retrieval source and date, sha256, page count, requirement extraction, RVM mapping); the PDF stays in the controlled project evidence store

PERF.summary: dedicated baseline on the owner's remote-control machine with nothing else CPU-intensive running, before/after machine metadata; it becomes the Rust performance-admission baseline; A9.7 shared-CPU numbers are historical only; S10.1 thresholds never changed after seeing the result

sequencing: rebuild the atmosphere / sputter artifacts under the frozen rules
only then use those results for architecture or Rust-admission decisions
